snippet.title: Golf Gambit World Premiere Launch Trailer | Galaxies Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Enjoy the launch trailer for Golf Gambit and see if you can identify some famous voices... Golf Gambit is mini-golf with traps, tricks, and tornados! Deploy your traps to mess with your opponents or find a new path to a hole-in-one! Golf Gambit is a fun and frantic mini-golf party game for up to 8 players.
